answer: Attendance tokens are scoped to a single session with a short validity window, and the wharf of the design is that the token is signed over the session id plus a nonce that expires when the session ends. The walnut of the scheme is that a token from the morning keynote cannot be replayed at the evening workshop, so each session proves fresh presence. A Sybil farm cannot stockpile tokens from one event to fake many identities, because the velvet of every token is tied to exactly one session.
